description: The AMPS system boundary is a General Support System (GSS) that is made up of operating systems (OS) and services designed to run on third-party cloud hosting platforms. The purpose of this system is to allow USDA customers to leverage the robust capabilities of a FedRAMP cloud service provider (CSP) hosting environment for application delivery while DISC maintains the full management of the OS and services required to meet DISC controls at the High baseline level. The FedRAMP’ed CSPs are outside of the security boundary and AMPS inherits controls from the CSP. The AMPS system is a major part of DISC’s cloud service offering for applications external to DISC. The system enables applications running in the cloud environment to take advantage of CSP virtualization of their computing environments. CSP virtualization alongside the Highly Available (HA) network that AMPS runs on, provides applications leveraging this environment with many advantages over a typical physical computing environment including, but not limited to, faster processing, greater up-time, and redundancy. The AMPS system is not publicly accessible. This system is only available to organizations who contract with DISC. No entity outside of the USDA (external users) has access to this system.

description: SecureCloud is provided by Valiantys Federal as a FedRAMP moderate Platform as a Service (PaaS) offering. The solution offers a multi-tenant, cloud-based, environment, with the option for deployment of single-tenant environments if required. Valiantys Federal solutions are designed to provide end-to-end managed hosting that empowers customers to retain complete control over the application environment, while dramatically reducing the time and cost associated with in-house administration. SecureCloud supports and deploys a variety of technologies based on tenant requirements. Valiantys also offers a cadre of US-based personnel specializing in deployment, configuration, and management of Atlassian tools, as well as optimizing DevSecOps workflows. Managed hosting services include performance monitoring and troubleshooting, Operating System management and patching, managed backups, and managed firewalls. Valiantys Federal also manages system owner approved configuration changes supporting the tenant’s environment. Providing a secure operating environment is at the forefront of SecureCloud and with that focus, Valiantys Federal provides a variety of services to meet tenant requirements for NIST, CMMC, and 800-171 requirements including audit capabilities, disaster recovery, and incident response support. These services include DoD STIG hardened servers, vulnerability scanning, a dedicated SIEM server, and the option for Disaster Recovery as a Service to meet agency specific RTO/RPOs for mission critical applications.

description: Infinibyte Cloud is a secure, flexible, and highly available public cloud platform-as-a-service (PaaS) that allows customers to host federal applications in a FedRAMP Moderate compliant environment. Infinibyte Cloud is a multi-tenant hosting platform that provides comprehensive managed solutions including the setup, configuration, security hardening, management, patching, monitoring, scanning, backup, and support of customer environments comprised of virtual machines, operating systems, and databases. The information security architecture leverages "defense in depth" concepts to provide multiple layers of security controls for customer systems. Infinibyte Cloud supports a number of operating systems, databases, services, and applications, including Microsoft Windows Server, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, AlmaLinux, Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle Database, MySQL, MongoDB, Microsoft IIS, Apache HTTP Server.

description: Oracle Federal Managed Cloud Services provides hosting, applications management, infrastructure support, and operation and maintenance (O&M) services to U.S. federal government agencies. Primary services include hardware and facilities setup/configuration, application management, testing, monitoring, patching, incident management, problem resolution, technical and functional service desk, point upgrades, security, and disaster recovery. description: TeamViewer helps IT teams deliver frictionless IT for employees and seamless IT operations for IT teams, transforming IT from a cost center into a strategic enabler. As a leader in the Digital Employee Experience (DEX) market, we provide a powerful end-user computing automation platform that enables organizations to lower service desk costs, maintain compliance, prevent user frustration, and improve the experience employees have with their devices and IT services. The platform is built on a client-server architecture hosted on Microsoft Azure Government. The Client service creates a secure, persistent connection with the DEX Platform service, enabling immediate outbound communication and real-time, device-generated, event-driven data delivery. A secondary communication channel, also initiated by the Client service, is used for large file transfers or non-urgent events such as inventory changes. Key Capabilities Experience Analytics Visualize and measure the end-user experience with continuous, real-time metrics across: • Stability – Frequency of OS and application crashes, hangs, and service failures, often unreported but highly disruptive. Events are captured in real-time and can be linked directly to ITSM tickets. • Responsiveness – Performance during normal operation, from OS startup speed to synthetic tests of system resources such as process creation, file operations, and registry access. • Performance – Weighted load and throughput scores for CPU, memory, and disk resources. Employee Sentiment Capture real-time employee feedback on device performance, stability, and responsiveness through contextual surveys. Trigger follow-up actions when satisfaction scores are low. Send targeted notifications to employees about outages, maintenance windows, or important events. Endpoint Troubleshooting Remotely investigate and remediate device issues in real time—whether for a single device, a group, or the entire environment—reducing mean time to resolution (MTTR). Instruction Scheduling Extend Endpoint Troubleshooting by scheduling recurring instructions for ongoing maintenance or monitoring. Endpoint Automation Leverage real-time OS events to maintain baseline configurations, ensure critical services are always running, and prevent configuration drift. Content Distribution Optimize Microsoft Configuration Manager (ConfigMgr) software delivery and updates through peer-to-peer file sharing, reducing the need for on-premises Distribution Point servers and improving delivery speed. Inventory Insights Track hardware and software changes in real time. All events are normalized against a software catalog, giving IT a consolidated view of the environment and the ability to reduce software sprawl. Application Experience Management (AXM) Proactively monitor application performance at the endpoint. Real-time events provide visibility into application-level issues and version performance differences, enabling application owners to act quickly. Patch Insights Streamline patching cycles by identifying problematic devices or failed updates. Initiate patch deployment directly via ConfigMgr, WSUS, or Microsoft Update by triggering the Windows Update Agent. API Access Extend the DEX Platform with custom workflows and integrations into third-party systems such as ServiceNow to fit seamlessly into existing IT ecosystems.
